title: toast 10s hover stick then float
rule: Toast: 10 seconds or while hovered; slide out the top; stick then float top-right on scroll — success that needs no action. Dual-cite Spectrum ≥5s vs Ant Message 3s; no house seconds.
pass_when: Duration is one named school applied consistently (Suomi.fi 10s or while hovered; Spectrum ≥5s; Ant 3s). Suomi.fi geometry when that school is used: stick-top then float top-right after scroll; slide-out dismiss; success with no required response.
fail_when: A house seconds value not in {10s+hover, ≥5s, 3s}; or a success-toast that requires a response; or collapsing the three durations into one house timer.
overview: Suomi toasts last 10s or while hovered, stick then float top-right, for action-free success.
apply_when: Success toasts that need no response when following the Suomi.fi toast school.
not_when: Inventing a house timer outside 10s+hover, Spectrum ≥5s, or Ant 3s.
agent_hint: Apply one named duration school; for Suomi use 10s/hover, stick-then-float, no required response.
description: Suomi.fi toasts show for 10 seconds or while hovered, slide out the top, stick then float top-right on scroll, and cover success that needs no action. Dual-cite Spectrum ≥5s and Ant Message 3s without inventing a house seconds value. Collapse those schools into one unmarked timer, or require a response on a success toast, and the pattern fails. Pick one named school and apply it consistently.
do_not_claim: A house toast duration; Notification first-load split as this row.
